## Projects

### metasurvey: Reproducible Survey Data Processing with Step Pipelines
::: {.justify}
An R package for integrating and analyzing survey data from multiple sources. Currently under review at [rOpenSci](https://github.com/ropensci/software-review/issues/752). The package provides a step-based pipeline for reproducible survey data processing, building on the `survey` package for complex sampling designs.

- Lazy step pipeline (`step_compute`, `step_recode`, `step_rename`, `step_remove`, `step_join`) that preserves sampling design metadata through every transformation.
- Recipe system for bundling transformation pipelines into portable, versioned objects with metadata and dependency tracking.
- STATA `.do` file transpiler that converts legacy institutional processing scripts into reproducible R pipelines.
- REST API and Shiny explorer for publishing, discovering, and sharing recipes across research teams.
- 90%+ test coverage, 25 vignettes (English and Spanish), R CMD check with 0 errors/warnings.

[GitHub](https://github.com/metasurveyr/metasurvey) | [Documentation](https://metasurveyr.github.io/metasurvey/) | [rOpenSci Review](https://github.com/ropensci/software-review/issues/752)
:::
